title: Broadcom’s Google And Anthropic AI Deals Deepen Custom Chip Reliance
title_zh: Broadcom 的 Google 和 Anthropic AI 交易加深了对定制芯片的依赖
summary: Broadcom (NasdaqGS:AVGO) has signed multi-year AI chip and infrastructure agreements with Google and Anthropic. The deals run through 2031 and cover exclusive custom silicon design and supply for next generation AI platforms.
summary_zh: Broadcom（纳斯达克GS：AVGO）已与谷歌和 Anthropic 签署了多年的人工智能芯片和基础设施协议。这些交易持续到 2031 年，涵盖下一代人工智能平台的独家定制芯片设计和供应。

title: Microsoft’s Carbon Deal Tests How AI Growth Meets Environmental Demands
title_zh: 微软的碳交易测试人工智能增长如何满足环境需求
summary: Microsoft has signed its first Canadian bioenergy carbon capture offtake agreement, partnering with Indigenous led consortiums to support carbon removal tied to digital infrastructure.
summary_zh: 微软签署了第一份加拿大生物能源碳捕获承购协议，与原住民领导的财团合作，支持与数字基础设施相关的碳清除。

title: Broadcom Stock Gains After Filing Reveals Deal With Google
title_zh: 博通股价在提交文件披露与谷歌的交易后上涨
summary: In a Monday afternoon filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission,  Broadcom  added some certainty to its relationship with Alphabet, for which it designs artificial-intelligence chips.  Broadcom stock rose 2.4% in after-hours trading.  Alphabet shares were unchanged.
summary_zh: 在周一下午向美国证券交易委员会提交的文件中，博通为其与 Alphabet 的关系增添了一些确定性，博通为其设计人工智能芯片。  博通股价在盘后交易中上涨 2.4%。  Alphabet 股票没有变化。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures fall as Trump deadline for Iran deal nears
title_zh: 今日股市：随着特朗普达成伊朗协议的最后期限临近，道指、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货下跌
summary: Markets are facing instability as a Trump-issued deadline for a deal with Iran fast approaches.
summary_zh: 随着特朗普设定的与伊朗达成协议的最后期限迅速临近，市场面临不稳定。

title: Broadcom signs long-term deal to develop Google’s custom AI chips
title_zh: 博通签署长期协议开发谷歌定制人工智能芯片
summary: Broadcom said on Monday it has signed a long-term agreement with Google to develop and ‌supply future generations of custom artificial intelligence chips and ‌other components for the company's next-generation AI racks through 2031.
summary_zh: 博通周一表示，已与谷歌签署了一项长期协议，到 2031 年为该公司的下一代人工智能机架开发和供应下一代定制人工智能芯片和其他组件。
